title: Consistency of Generalised Probabilistic Theories is Undecidable
summary: Generalised Probabilistic Theories (GPTs) provide a unifying framework encompassing classical theories, quantum theories, as well as hypothetical alternatives. We investigate both the problem of extending a system with a finite set of transformations, and the problem of adding to a translation-invariant set of systems a finite set of entangled states and effects, plus all their images under the translation symmetry.
